title: Degree-zero derived base change respects the augmentations
statement: Let $B,B\prime,C,C\prime$ be abelian categories with derived categories, and assume enough injectives in $B,B\prime$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $G:B\to C$ and $G\prime:B\prime\to C\prime$ be additive left exact functors, and let $\beta:B\to B\prime$, $\gamma:C\to C\prime$ be additive exact functors [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology]. For a natural transformation $e:G\gamma\to\beta G\prime$, write $R^0e$ for its degree-zero derived base-change transformation and $a_G:G\to R^0G$, $a_{G\prime}:G\prime\to R^0G\prime$ for the canonical augmentations [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero]. For every $Y$ in $B$, $\gamma(a_G(Y));R^0e(Y)=e(Y);a_{G\prime}(\beta Y)$. Here semicolons mean composition in the written order.

proof.text: Rewrite rightDerivedBaseChange using rightDerivedBaseChange_app. Identify both classical augmentations with the homology unit followed by the single-complex comparison. Map the source composite through gamma and cancel the comparison with its inverse.
Apply the homology base-change unit equation to the remaining composite, then compose with the target single-complex comparison and reassociate.
